name: Inui Azusa
source: Azusa is a member of Enoshima, the famous and powerful gang founded by Renna. She's considered the smartest person in the gang and is the second in command after Renna. She's the fastest too and can always run away when the gang is losing a fight, thus she never lost a battle. She's mischievous and likes to flirt with Hiroshi. She absolutely loves mayonnaise.
